final_draft.answer: Changes to the default branch (main) of our application repository (harborlight/app on GitHub) need one approving review before they can be merged, and the rule applies to administrators as well.

arguments.query: approving reviews required before merge to main branch, branch protection

answer:c3d69527-9089-4e94-af46-f9f8e9f4f: Yes. Changes to the default branch of our application repository (harborlight/app on GitHub) require two approving reviews before they can be merged, and the rule applies to administrators as well.
answer:d597113e-2001-4d5e-a3c9-73e1c4804: Yes. Our GitHub organisation (harborlight) requires two-factor sign-in for all of its members.
answer:52266ce9-ad31-4d74-8a15-286b249d8: Yes. GitHub secret scanning is switched on for our application repository (harborlight/app).
answer:107c1ef8-41f9-4cbe-afd2-b621c76eb: An independent firm performs a penetration test of the application and infrastructure once a year. A summary letter is available under NDA.
answer:a4702f51-23b0-454d-8b16-07a47ee39: Infrastructure and container images are scanned weekly. Critical findings are fixed within 7 days and high findings within 30 days.
